notes.en: Aimed for a clean dual-pose Vitruvian Man with generous gold base shapes that survive at navbar size. Tiered ink etch defines anatomy through pectoral curves, rib arch, iliac crest, navel, and kneecap ovals. Still weak: the lower together-legs are narrower than ideal through the shin, the knees appear as floating oval outlines rather than fully integrated into the leg contour, and the spread-pose feet are minimal wedge shapes that only hint at foot structure. The four-arm four-leg overlay reads clearly at large sizes; at 38px the gold silhouette reduces to a recognizable cross-limbed figure.
